headline: North-West revenue dropped mainly because late deliveries drove away our biggest accounts.
body: Our warehouse delays pushed enterprise customers like Meridian and Kalinga to pause orders and look at competitors [E1]. That single region accounts for most of the region's revenue loss this month. Rising complaints and slower conversion added smaller hits on top, but late shipments are the real story [E4].

actions.action: Add overflow capacity at WH-07 immediately
actions.expected_impact: Clear backlog and restore SLA within two weeks
actions.monitoring: Track daily SLA % and backlog count at WH-07

actions.action: Offer SLA guarantee to at-risk enterprise accounts
actions.expected_impact: Retain Meridian and Kalinga renewal volume
actions.monitoring: Watch enterprise active account count weekly

what_could_change: If WH-07 backlog clears and SLA recovers, we'd expect enterprise orders to bounce back within weeks.
caveats: This is based on this month's data only; if new accounts churn for other reasons, the story could shift.
